login.ruleMix: Mixing letters and digits is recommended

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Runtime overview: GPU memory and utilization trends, container / inference metrics, disk usage and event log stream.

models.title: Models
models.description: Model configuration list and status management: status, name, quantization, size and actions, with parameter editing and a creation wizard.
models.errorRequest: Request failed, please try again later
models.emptyDescription: Create a model via the API (POST /api/v1/models), or wait for the M2 download wizard to download models from Hugging Face.
models.footnote: Single model at a time: starting a model stops the current one · Quant labels are detected from file names

modelEdit.title: Edit model
modelEdit.namespaceHint: Changing the namespace only regroups the entry; files are not moved. Cross-namespace references are expressed in the GGUF path
modelEdit.ggufHint: Relative to the models root; shard globs supported (e.g. main/Qwen-*-00001-of-00002.gguf)
modelEdit.mmprojHint: Optional vision projector for multimodal models; leave empty for none
modelEdit.previewSubtitle: Final launch parameters merged from defaults and overrides
modelEdit.previewSummary: {count} overrides · restart the model after saving to apply
modelEdit.previewInvalid: Current input failed validation; preview shows defaults merged: {message}
modelEdit.dangerDescription: Removes only the configuration record (including overrides); GGUF files stay on disk.
modelEdit.dangerConfirmDescription: This cannot be undone; model files are not deleted.
modelEdit.errorConflict: Model is running: editing and deletion are blocked. Stop it first
modelEdit.errorNotFound: Model not found; it may have been deleted
modelEdit.errorRequest: Request failed, please try again later
modelEdit.errorNetwork: Network error, please check the panel service and retry

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.description: Model download management: task progress / speed / shard details, resumable transfers with sha256 verification, mirror sources and history.

files.title: Files
files.description: Browse GGUF files: disk usage overview, directory tree + file table, with move / delete actions on selection.

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.description: Real-time monitoring: GPU / container / inference metric cards with sparklines and a full-width terminal log stream.

chat.title: Chat
chat.description: Built-in chat debugging: talks to the local inference service directly to validate model parameters and output.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Panel settings: admin password, API token management and panel runtime preferences.
